item.title: Melania Trump delivers statement denying Epstein ties, knowledge of his crimes
item.summary: US first lady Melania Trump gave an extraordinary statement from the White House on Thursday denying any ties to late financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. Trump said the "lies" linking her to Epstein were "mean-spirited attempts" to defame her reputation.
